Commentary.Commentary: The local boy CHETESHWAR PUJARA comes in at 3.

A minimum of 49 overs are left and the target of 310 is definitely improbable considering the surface. It's very slow and while batting is not difficult at all, you need a grinding approach to score runs. So, racking up runs at 6 rpo is next to impossible. England haven't given India any sniff with this declaration. This means that the visitors can have men around the bat from the very beginning. How will the hosts reply? Will they have a go? The chase isn't far away.

Another solid batting performance by the visitors. The big opening partnership set things up. Hameed missed out on a ton but the skipper didn't and was eventually dismissed only while trying to up the ante. Mishra and Ashwin were the wicket-takers but it was mainly due to the batsmen's over-aggression. There was considerable intent from England today and they have given themselves a slight crack at the Indians.

OUT! COOK DEPARTS, ENGLAND HAVE DECLARED! Floated outside leg, Cook steps out and makes room for the inside out lofted stroke but miscues it. Jadeja at long off takes the skier with ease. Ends a great innings from the England captain. INDIA NEED 310 RUNS TO WIN.
Floated well outside off, Cook is beaten on the slash!
Floated outside leg, Cook goes for the sweep but is hit on the pad.
Full and on off, Cook makes room to play the lofted drive but gets a slice that goes to third man on the bounce.
Length ball on leg stump, Cook shuffles to flick but is hit on the pads.
Shortish on leg stump, Stokes goes for the pull but it goes off the pads to the leg side. They take a leg bye.
Full and outside off, Stokes drills it hard towards mid off.
Dug in short on middle, Stokes looks to pull but gets it off the forearm towards Saha.
FOUR! Superb batting! Fuller outside off, Stokes shuffles and whips it away powerfully to the deep backward square leg fence. Amazing shot!
Darted well outside leg, pulled away down to fine leg for a single.
Floated outside off, dabbed towards point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, steps out and drills it down to long off for a single.
Floated around leg stump, Stokes makes room to drive but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Tossed up wider outside off, Cook thumps it to deep cover for a single.
Floated outside leg, Cook looks to flick but misses.
Length ball wider outside off, Cook glides it to third man for a single.
Good length angled away wider outside off, Cook looks to steer it down to third man but misses.
Length ball wider outside off, Cook chases it with a wild drive but misses.

WASTE OF A REVIEW! Full and outside off, Cook chases it as it goes through to Saha. There was some noise as the Indians appeal for a catch. Turned down by the umpire and Kohli opts for the review. Replays show that there is daylight between bat and ball. Quite a lot of deceptive noises in this match off the track. 'Demons' maybe?
India have taken a review for caught behind against Cook.
FOUR! SMACK! That made a cracking sound off the bat! Full and outside off, Cook leans into it and thumps it with aplomb through extra cover. That went to the fence in a jiffy.
Short and wide outside off, Stokes chases it but gets an edge that goes down to third man for a single.
UMESH YADAV is back on.
Full and outside leg, Stokes steps out and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Floated on middle and leg, swept away down to fine leg for a single.
50-run stand between Cook and Stokes.
Floated outside leg, Stokes goes for the reverse sweep but misses. Saha fumbles down the leg side and concedes a bye.
Floated well outside leg, Cook steps out and adjusts to tuck it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside leg, Cook reaches out and blocks it out.
FOUR! Hammered! Mishra'a losing the plot here. Full toss this time and Stokes clobbers it to the deep mid-wicket fence for another boundary. England now on the rampage at the moment. Lead is now 289.
FOUR! Stokes joins in the fun! Tossed up wider around middle and off, Cook gets across to that one and sweeps it powerfully to the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Drifting in from around off, Cook works it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Finds the fence! Floated outside leg, Cook gets well across and sweeps it comfortably to the long leg fence for a boundary. Poor ball from Mishra.
Slider on middle and off, worked away behind square for a single.
Floated wider outside off, Stokes jams it back at Mishra who does well to get a hand on it. Parries it to mid off.
Drifting in from outside leg, Cook looks to flick but is struck on the pads.
The ball has lost its shape. The fourth umpire comes out with the replacement.
Loopy on a length around leg, Cook looks to block but gets an edge towards the off side.
Drifting in from outside leg, tucked towards mid-wicket with the turn.
Loopy on a length around leg stump, Cook looks to flick but is struck on the thigh.

FOUR! TERRIFIC SHOT! Floated outside leg, Cook charges down the track and makes ample room to launch it inside out over the covers. Picked his spot to perfection. What a way to bring up 1000 Test runs in India.
Floated around leg stump, Cook looks to paddle it but is hit on the thigh.

Drops it short outside off, Stokes goes back to pull it over mid-wicket. Mistimes it a bit but falls well short of the fielder in the deep. Single taken.

Fuller around leg stump, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
That spun with a bounce! Floated outside leg, turns away with a puff of dust. Explodes to square Stokes all ends up.

Drifting well down the leg side, Cook paddles it but can't beat short fine leg.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN to bowl from the other end.
Beaten! Floated outside off, Stokes pushes at it but is beaten as that kicks up off the deck.

Welcome back for the second session. Let's see when England will declare. It should be inside the next 5-6 overs or so I assume. AMIT MISHRA to continue his spell.
.....DAY 5, SESSION 2.....

India's bowlers continued to struggle in getting much out of the pitch. There were brief moments where they got the ball to rear with turn but it didn't happen consistently enough to trouble the batsmen. Mishra bowled a testing spell and got rewarded with a couple of wickets as England entered into declaration mode. The lead is 260 now and the declaration seems imminent after lunch. It shall be interesting to see how many runs Cook decides on. The track still looks good but surely, only one team can lose from here. Join us in a while for the second session.

Another good session for the visitors. The openers continued to milk the bowling around. There were glimpses of some turn and extra bounce but those instances were far and few in between. Hameed missed out on a well-deserved ton when he was dismissed by a blinder from Mishra off his own bowling. The leggie then removed Root cheaply too as the visitors were pressing for quick runs. Meanwhile, Cook dug in to register his 30th Test ton, smashing several records in the process.
Change of pace! Slower off cutter outside off, Cook picks it up, leans ahead and pushes it wide of mid off for a single. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Alastair lunges forward and plays a free flowing drive but fails to pierce the off side field.

MOHAMMED SHAMI comes back to bowl. This is the last over before Lunch.

30th Test ton for Cook. He now has the most tons by a visiting player in India, most by an English captain as well. What a player!
Cook drives it with the spin through mid on for a single. He thumps his fists in the air and it has been a brilliant knock! The crowd cheers his effort. Well done Cook!

Well bowled! Slips in a quick googly outside off, Cook looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.

We are ready to kick start the first session. The players and umpires walk out in the middle. It will be interesting to see how COOK and HAMEED build their innings today. Will India make early inroads today? ASHWIN to start the proceedings. Here we go...

Cook and Hameed have applied themselves well and especially the youngster has been a class apart. It needs to be seen what kind of mindset the English batsmen come out with and that could well decide the fate of this contest. The hosts are the No. 1 side in the world and expect them to give it their best shot. Another cracker of a day awaits!

Hello and a warm welcome on the final day of the first Test match between India and England in Rajkot. England have secured a lead of 163 and are boarded safely at the harbor at the moment but cricket is a game of glorious uncertainties. The tides may turn around and catch the English side off guard. For now, the game is heading towards a draw but the duo of Ashwin and Jadeja can prove to be venomous on this track as the pitch has started to crumble.
...DAY 5, SESSION 1...

Earlier in the day, Ashwin shepherded the lower order as India got to 488 despite losing Kohli and Rahane in the first hour of the morning. Rashid's 4-fer was the highlight today for the visitors as they managed to get a handy lead. India did well to reduce the deficit with some dogged batting. The match looks to be heading for a tame draw unless Cook decides to make a sporting declaration tomorrow once the lead goes past 260 or so. The ball is definitely in England's court. Tune in at 0930 IST for the final day. Till then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Superb opening partnership for England to neutralize whatever pressure that could have mounted on them. It means that they have ended the day on a high. Although they had gained a lead of 49, a few early strikes could have dented them. India's marathon batting effort had meant that England were the only side that could lose with the little time left in the match. Cook and Hameed put all those doubts to rest with a solid partnership, the debutant notching up his maiden fifty as well. The duo has countered everything that the Indians have thrown at them and have looked largely untroubled.

Tossed up around off, Hameed presses forward and blocks.
Cook helps it with the turn through square leg for a single.
NO BALL! Full on off, defended off the front foot to short leg. Mishra overstepped and the umpire signals a no ball.
Outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
Maiden Test fifty for Hameed.

FOUR! WELL PLAYED! A touch short outside off, spinning away. Hameed rocks back and cuts it late to find the third man fence. It has been a fine knock under pressure by the youngster. Needs to carry on!
Spinning back into Cook. He comes forward and gets it from the outer half round the corner for a single.
Full outside off, defended with the inner half to short leg.

NOT OUT! Bowls it back of a length wide outside off, turning back sharply. Hameed goes back deep in the crease and chooses to pad it away at the last moment. India appeal strongly for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Virat consults with his teammates and takes the review. The replays show that it would have missed the off stump. The impact was way outside off.
India decide to take a review against Haseeb Hameed. It is regarding an LBW decision.
This time he turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A touch short on off, spinning away. Cook goes back and punches it towards cover-point.
Comes forward and manages to defend it from the outer half towards point.
Floated on off, presses forward and defends towards mid off.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to Kohli at short cover.
Slow through the air on off, Hameed shaps to play the drive but ends up slicing it to point.
Floated around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Tosses it up outside off, turning away. Hameed lets it go.
Tosses it up nicely on off, spinning away sharply. Hameed makes a watchful leave.
Cook plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
AMIT MISHRA comes on to bowl.
FOUR! SHOT! Shortish ball outside off, spinning in. Hameed stays back and cuts it through covers for a superb boundary.
Straighter one outside off, Hameed plays inside the line but gets it from the outer half of his bat towards point.
Tossed up outside off, Hameed lunges forward and blocks it.
Going down leg, turned to the on side for a single.
Presses forward to the loopy delivery and defends it into the ground.
On a length around off, Cook stays back and defends it to the off side.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes back.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Shortish and wide outside off, Haseeb throws his bat at it but gets an edge to third man. Single taken!
Back of a length ball angling into Hameed. He rises with the bounce and keeps it down on the track.
Full length delivery outside off, driven  it to the point where Rahane puts a good effort to save some runs for his side.
Fullish delivery swinging away appreciably. Ahmed drives away from his body and gets beaten. Loose shot that one from the solid opener.
Back of a length pacy delivery outside off, Haseeb rises with the bounce and taps it to the man at point.
In the corridor of uncertainty, leaves the southpaw this time. He watches it closely and lets it through.
On a good length shaping in from outside off, Cook is right behind that one as he presents a compact defense to the covers.
On a good length, Alastair Cook comes forward and defends it to mid off.
Fullish delivery outside off, Cook pushes it with soft hands to covers.
On a length outside off, Hameed drops his wrists and runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, width on offer. Cook cuts it hard through point. Gambhir in the deep runs across to cut it off and keeps it down to one.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Hameed plays a free flowing drive but finds the man at extra cover.
Straying on the pads, Haseeb turns it behind square and runs well between the wickets to complete the second.
Full length ball outside off, played with an angled bat to point.
On a length on middle, Cook stays back and tucks it wide of mid on for a single.
Fullish delivery, angling away wide outside off. Cook shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Very full outside off, pushes it with soft hand towards mid off.
On a length angling into middle and leg, Hameed stays back and defends it towards mid on.
Similar line and length once again, Hameed resists the temptation.
Fuller length ball outside off once again, Hameed makes another leave.
On a driving length outside off, Haseeb goes for the drive but gets it from the inner half of his bat to mid off.
Fullish ball wide outside off, Haseeb leaves it alone
Full length ball outside off, Hameed comes forward and points his bat skywards to let it through.
Drinks break....
Cook has adopted a circumspect approach. Bowls it fullish wide outside off, luring Cook to play the drive. But he is no mood to flirt with those!
Length delivery outside off, Cook stays back and leaves it alone.
Wayward delivery!  Sprays it down very wide outside off, Cook has nothing to do with it.
On a good length, angling away outside off. Cook lets it go through.
There is a slight issue with the sightscreen. It is resolved now and we are ready to go.
Good length ball, angling away. Cook leaves it alone.
On a length on off, Cook stays back and defends it to the covers.
Fullish ball outside off, Hameed looks to play at first but withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Back of a length ball, shaping in. Hameed rises with the bounce and defends it to point.
On a length outside off, Hameed points his bat skywards and lets it sail though to the keeper.
Straying on the pads, Hameed clips it to long leg this time. Couple taken!
Angling into the pads, easy pickings for Cook as he clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Good delivery! On a good length angling in from around the wicket, Cook stays back and plays inside the line but gets beaten all ends up.
MOHAMMED SHAMI comes back to bowl.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the front foot on to the pitch.
Length ball well down the leg side, Hameed misses the flick.
Good length outside off, a hint of shape away, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and closer to off, Hameed makes another leave.
Fuller outside off, Hameed reaches out and eases it through the covers for a brace.
Length ball outside off, Hameed pokes at it but is beaten.
Darted in around off, spins in sharply to rap Cook on the thighs.
Drifting in on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, jammed towards cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans into it and pushes it towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, pushed off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Flatter outside off, Hameed defends it well from the crease.
Good length angled in closer to off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
FOUR! Nicely struck! Dug in short on off, Cook swivels and pulls it away powerfully over square leg to find the fence. Authoritative stroke from the England captain.
Back of a length outside off, Hameed glides it down to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length outside off, steered towards point for a single.
UMESH YADAV comes on to bowl.
Drifting in from outside off, Hameed presses forward and pushes it past silly point.
Floated outside off, turns in sharply as Cook nudges it down to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, very full and Hameed places it through point for a single.
Speared in on off, Hameed presses forward to that one and smothers it.
Darted in on middle and leg, worked off the back foot through square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
FOUR! Slapped away! Ashwin drops it short around off, Cook gets back and pulls it away hard to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Brings up the 50-run opening stand too. Fine partnership.
Finds the edge but doesn't carry! Lovely off break outside off, Cook gets the outside edge that falls short of Rahane at first slip.
Fuller on middle and leg, Cook gets across and defends it well.
Slider outside off, Cook comes forward and blocks it well to the off side.
Flatter on middle and leg, clipped off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a quick single. Nearly a collision between the two openers, Hameed would have been blown away had it happened.
Floated outside off, Hameed reaches out to that one and blocks it well.
Fired in around off, Hameed gets back and steers it to gully for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Hameed gets across and smothers it to the ground.
Drifting in on off, Hameed presses forward and blocks it solidly to the track.
Flatter and fuller outside off, Cook digs it towards cover for a single.
Speared in on middle and leg, Cook gets back to flick but misses. Lobs off the thigh pad and doesn't carry to short leg.
Slider around off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
What a ball! Floated around off, draws Hameed forward but the ball rears off the deck to beat the outside edge.
Loopy on middle and off, Cook thumps it down to long on for a single.
Loopy on middle and leg, Hameed drills it down to long on for a single.
Floated on off, Hameed drives it firmly towards mid on.
Floated around off, Hameed presses forward to block but is struck on the thigh pad. Appeal for lbw but just a bit high.
Floated on middle and leg, worked off the back foot behind square for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Hameed presses forward and defends it out.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot to the ground.
Flatter outside off, blocked from the crease.
Outside off, spins a bit away. Hameed lets it go through to the keeper.
Darted in from outside off, Hameed pushes at it but gets the edge that goes past gully for a brace.
Fired in around off, Hameed defends it well from the crease.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans into it and defends well.
Superb ball! Floated outside off, turns away sharply to whiz past the outside edge. Extra bounce too.
Drifting in on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Cook presses forward to block away.
Drifting in from outside off, Cook leans into it and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans into it and blocks it well.
Fuller outside off, Hameed gets well forward to that one and defends it out.
Drifting in from outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Tossed up outside off, gets well forward to that one and defends it well.
Darted in on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Cracking ball! Floated around off, explodes off the rough with sharp turn to beat the outside edge comprehensively.
Darted in on middle and leg, Cook works it with the spin down to fine leg for a single.
Slider outside off, defended well off the back foot.
FOUR! FAB SHOT! Tossed up outside off, Hameed reaches out to that one and thumps it elegantly through extra cover to find another boundary. This is extremely good batting from the debutant.
FOUR! Delicately done! Floated on a length outside off, Hameed gets back to that one and glides it with an open face towards the third man fence for a boundary. He was in total control there.
Flatter outside off, Hameed reaches out and defends it well.
Fuller outside off, Hameed gets well forward and defends it well.
Floated off break outside off, extra bounce but not much turn as Hameed pads up. Stifled lbw appeal but it didn't spin enough.
Drifting in on middle and leg, blocked well off the back foot down the track.
Loopy and outside off, Cook gets on the front foot and dead bats it away.
Loopy outside off, Cook presses forward to that one and smothers it to the ground.
Tossed up around off, Cook leans into it and defends it with a straight bat.

Five runs! Bonus runs! Floated outside off, Hameed gets back and jabs it towards point to Shami for a quick single. Direct hit at the bowler's end ricochets and goes all the way towards the long on fence. Kohli isn't happy at all.
Flatter on a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Loopy on a length outside off, Hameed hangs back and dabs it to the covers for a quick single.
Tossed up fuller outside off, Hameed bunts it back to the bowler.
Darted in on middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy on off, Cook presses forward and defends it solidly.
Flighted outside off, Cook leans into it and smothers it to the ground.
Drifting in from outside off, Cook gets back and blocks it out.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes on to bowl.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Fuller around off, gets well forward and blocks it solidly.
SIX! Clubbed! Brave stroke from the young debutant. Tossed up ball on off, Hameed charges down the track and hoists it over long off for a maximum. Good positive batting.
Tossed up outside off, Cook gets back and steers it to short third man for a single.
Slider outside off, a touch short and Cook cuts it late through backward point for a brace.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, cracking drive from Hameed but straight to cover.
Good length closer to off, Hameed pokes at it with soft hands. The outside edge goes on the bounce to gully.
Fullish around off, Hameed gets forward and drives it towards mid off.
Full and outside off, shaping away, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Hameed misses the flick.
In the air....falls safe! Short ball and Cook goes for the pull. Miscues it high towards deep square leg where it falls short of Pujara who tries to reach to the ball but in vain. Single taken.
Fuller around off, Hameed gets forward and blocks it.
Almost a chance! Tossed up around off, turns in with extra bounce off the rough. Goes off the glove and just over a leaping Vijay at short leg. Single taken.
FOUR! Deft touch! Speared in on middle and off, Cook gets back and nudges it with soft hands. Gets it past leg gully to find the fence. He was in total control there.
Tossed up outside off, Cook gets the stride forward to block well.
Slider on middle and leg, dug out off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Slider around off, no room to cut and Hameed chops it towards backward point.
Good length sliding well down the leg side, Cook misses the tickle. Good stop by Saha diving to his right.
Fuller on middle and leg, Hameed clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Hameed covers the line and blocks it down the track.
Length ball wider outside off, Cook steers it to deep backward point for a single.
Good length outside off, Cook reaches out and blocks it out.
Good length well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Slider on off, Hameed gets back and blocks it out.
Fired in around off, keeps a touch low as Cook jams it towards the leg side. Single taken.
Slider outside off, Cook goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge that goes just past off stump.

Huge appeal! Floated outside off, Cook gets back to flick but the ball turns in sharply to rap him on the pads. Huge shout for lbw but not given. Looked close, replays show that it would have clipped leg stump. 50-50 call then.
Flatter around off, Cook hangs back and pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up outside off, Cook pushes at it as the ball goes off the inside half to short leg.
RAVINDRA JADEJA to share the new ball.
Fuller outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot down the track.
Short of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Low full toss on the pads, Hameed gets across and glances it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. He was quick to pounce on the offering.
Full and outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle and leg, dug out towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball angled in on middle and leg, tailing in, Cook misses the flick and is rapped on the pads. Muted lbw appeal but it was going down leg. The batsmen pick up a leg bye.
